svg.title: Cambodia and Vietnam · courts, colonies and modern states
svg.desc: Selected, sourced connections. Arrows label unions, divisions, conquest, independence, changes in rule, and contact. Node positions do not measure time or ancestry. Two connected regional strands, with colonial and modern regime changes distinguished from enduring Khmer and Vietnamese communities. Ancient Vietnamese dynasties not already in the timeline are outside this selected expansion. Select a node for Wikipedia or an arrow for its sources.
